name: claude-token-meter
description: Token efficiency pane, token & tool check pane, and session-size alerts for Claude Code — in one mod, following your language setting.

effWarn.title: Efficiency warning line (%)
effWarn.description: Red below this efficiency (start load ÷ current context).

alertSteps.title: Alert steps (%)
alertSteps.description: Comma-separated efficiency levels; an alert fires the first time efficiency drops below each.

wasteTokens.title: Waste threshold (tokens)
wasteTokens.description: A turn that grows the context by more than this is logged as waste.

cacheMinChat.title: Cache alert minimum (tokens)
cacheMinChat.description: Skip the cache-expiry alert when the conversation part is smaller than this.

startPayload.title: Heavy start load (tokens)
startPayload.description: Warn when the first response's input is larger than this.

keepDays.title: Log retention (days)
keepDays.description: Rows older than this are trimmed from the log files.
